name: Mozilla Security
description: Mozilla's bug bounty program covering Firefox, Thunderbird, and Mozilla web properties. Running since 2004 with open-source model where all fixes are publicly auditable.

peerReview.processDescription: Researchers submit via Bugzilla. Mozilla security team triages for validity and impact. Patches developed. Disclosure coordinated. Running since 2004. Open-source model means all fixes publicly auditable.

attribution.attributionNotes: Researchers credited in security advisories. Bug Bounty Hall of Fame referenced but not verifiable.

povsAlignment.description: Code repository contribution through open-source bug bounty program with public auditability.
